moments.title: Commonwealth Games Wrap-Up
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games concluded on August 2nd, with athletes from 74 nations competing across various sports.

angles.name: Glasgow's Games Legacy
angles.copy: Glasgow just wrapped up a fantastic Commonwealth Games! What was your favourite moment from the last 11 days of action?

angles.name: Sporting Heroes
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow might be over, but the memories of incredible sporting achievements live on. Who was your standout athlete?

moments.title: Ian Broudie turns 68
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the English musician, songwriter, and producer best known as the frontman of The Lightning Seeds, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ian Broudie
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds! What's your favourite hit from the 'Three Lions' legend?

angles.name: Lightning Seeds Love
angles.copy: From 'Lucky You' to 'Three Lions', Ian Broudie has given us so many anthems. Celebrating his 68th birthday today!

moments.title: Paul Reynolds turns 64
moments.blurb: Paul Reynolds, the English guitarist for the iconic 80s new wave band A Flock of Seagulls, celebrates his 64th birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to Paul Reynolds, the guitarist from A Flock of Seagulls! 'I Ran (So Far Away)' is still an absolute banger.

angles.name: Iconic 80s Sound
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to Paul Reynolds! His guitar work helped define the sound of the 80s with A Flock of Seagulls.

moments.title: Max Cavalera turns 57
moments.blurb: Brazilian heavy metal icon Max Cavalera, known for his work with Sepultura, Soulfly, and Cavalera Conspiracy, celebrates his 57th birthday today.

angles.name: Metal Mayhem Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the legendary Max Cavalera! What's your favourite track from Sepultura or Soulfly?

angles.name: Heavy Metal Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a headbanging 57th birthday to Max Cavalera! A true pioneer of heavy metal.

moments.title: Sidmouth Folk Festival Live
moments.blurb: The renowned Sidmouth Folk Festival, featuring diverse folk music, dance, and workshops, is currently live in Devon and runs until August 7th.

angles.name: Folk Fun in Sidmouth
angles.copy: The Sidmouth Folk Festival is in full swing until Friday! If you're in Devon, are you soaking up the music and atmosphere?

angles.name: Devon's Folk Heartbeat
angles.copy: Sidmouth is alive with folk music, dance & storytelling! The festival continues until August 7th – who's heading down?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining international surfing, BMX, skate events, and live music, kicks off tomorrow in Newquay, Cornwall, running until August 9th.

angles.name: Cornwall's Biggest Party
angles.copy: Get ready, Cornwall! Boardmasters kicks off tomorrow with an epic mix of surf, skate, and live music until Sunday. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Boardmasters Countdown
angles.copy: Newquay is about to get wild! Boardmasters starts Wednesday – expect big waves and even bigger tunes. Are you there?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, becoming the longest-running No. 1 single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top, breaking a 73-year record.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: 19 weeks at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just broke a 73-year record. Is it your favourite No. 1 ever?

angles.name: Rein Me In Reigns
angles.copy: An incredible achievement! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are officially in the history books with 'Rein Me In'. What a track!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' New Entry
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's new track 'Petal' has debuted at No. 3 on the Official Singles Chart Update this week.

angles.name: New Ariana Hit
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' is a brand new entry at No. 3 on the Official Chart Update! Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Chart Climber
angles.copy: Big news for Arianators! 'Petal' is already climbing high. Could it reach the top spot?

moments.title: Brecon Jazz Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The Brecon Jazz Festival brings its vibrant programme of jazz music to various venues in Brecon, Wales, from August 7th to 9th.

angles.name: Jazz in Brecon
angles.copy: Brecon Jazz Festival is back this weekend, August 7-9! Who's ready for some incredible live jazz in Mid Wales?

angles.name: Welsh Jazz Vibes
angles.copy: Don't miss the Brecon Jazz Festival from Friday! A fantastic weekend of music across Brecon. Get your tickets!

moments.title: Swansea Sea Festival
moments.blurb: Swansea city centre will host the free Swansea Sea Festival on August 8th and 9th, celebrating maritime heritage with music, displays, and family activities.

angles.name: Set Sail Swansea!
angles.copy: The Swansea Sea Festival hits the city this weekend, Aug 8-9! Free family fun, live music & maritime magic. See you there?

angles.name: Maritime Weekend
angles.copy: Celebrating Swansea's rich maritime history this Saturday and Sunday at the free Swansea Sea Festival! Loads to see and do.

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, blending hip-hop music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Roots Picnic Lands in London
angles.copy: Hip-hop and culture unite! The legendary Roots Picnic makes its UK debut this weekend at Crystal Palace Bowl, London. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: London's New Festival
angles.copy: Roots Picnic UK is set to bring world-class performances to London this Saturday and Sunday. Get ready for an unforgettable weekend!

moments.title: Anthony Raneri turns 44
moments.blurb: Anthony Raneri, the lead vocalist and guitarist for the American rock band Bayside, celebrates his 44th birthday on August 9th.

angles.name: Bayside Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a rockin' 44th Birthday to Anthony Raneri of Bayside on Friday! What's your top Bayside track?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Anthony
angles.copy: Celebrating Anthony Raneri's 44th birthday this Friday! The Bayside frontman continues to deliver incredible rock anthems.

moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: Birmingham will host the European Athletics Championships from August 10th to 16th, marking the first time Britain has welcomed this prestigious event with over 1,500 elite athletes.

angles.name: Athletics Comes Home
angles.copy: History in the making! The European Athletics Championships kicks off in Birmingham on Monday, August 10th. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: Birmingham's Big Week
angles.copy: Get ready for a week of world-class athletics! Birmingham hosts the European Championships from August 10th. It's going to be epic!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting August 14th.

angles.name: Wembley Goes XO
angles.copy: The Weeknd takes over Wembley Stadium for five nights starting August 14th! Who's ready for the 'After Hours Til Dawn' experience?

angles.name: Abel at Wembley
angles.copy: Five nights of The Weeknd at Wembley! It kicks off August 14th. Get ready for an incredible show.

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine' residency at London's O2 Arena on August 15th, her first UK live shows in six years.

angles.name: Ariana's London Takeover
angles.copy: London, get ready! Ariana Grande starts her epic 10-night O2 residency on August 15th. Who managed to snag tickets?

angles.name: Eternal Sunshine Live
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's return to the UK stage is almost here! Her O2 residency kicks off next week. It's going to be HUGE.

moments.title: FA Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Arsenal and Manchester City will contest the FA Community Shield on August 16th at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, marking its return to the Welsh capital for the first time in 20 years.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Community Shield
angles.copy: Football is coming to Cardiff! The Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal vs. Man City in the Community Shield on August 16th. Are you ready?

angles.name: Welsh Football Fever
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the football season is in Wales this year! Arsenal take on Man City next Sunday. Who's winning?
